title: 第1171章 吴雪成霸道总裁了第1170章 我出三千万
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
吴雪成霸道总裁了？林默又观察了一下两人的微表情，得出了结论，这两人都在演戏。
因为两人都有很严重的表演痕迹。
这手段很高明，让两个富豪在网路上隔空要价，能够增加一堆讨论的话题。
富豪的身份，出价等等。
当然，所有的一切都是为了抬高吴雪那幅画的含金量。
艺术界的评价太过抽象，心理治疗师的评价能够理解，但不够具体。
而富豪的出价最直观，最具冲击力！
所有步骤加起来，就是一套完美的炒作组合拳！
观众可能不懂什么叫做“画家与灵魂对话”但大家肯定懂“三千万”
想着林默笑着摇摇头：“能够请动两位身价百亿的富豪出来互动，这郭教授的能量可不小啊。”
继续播放陆行舟的视频。
只见他报完价格放下纸条后对着镜头十分较真的说道：
陈总，你分得清，你看得准，你最懂了。好，那我问你，你在凌晨三点那幅画的时候，有没有觉得那团轮廓动了一下？
你有没有关了灯又打开，去看它还在不在原位？
看着我的眼睛回答我！”
陆行舟死死的盯着屏幕，硬是盯了十几秒才继续道：
“陈总，你知道吗，我不管什么时间，什么地点，什么角度，去看那幅画，都能够感受到另外一番体验！只要盯着它我就能体验不一样的感受，所以我认为它值这三千万！”
说完这句话的时候，陆行舟的嘴唇都在颤抖。
看完林默都在感叹，陆行舟业余时间是不是辅修了演戏？
这演技不知道比市面上那些小鲜肉强多少倍了。

视频发出后，陈伯达的回应在十分钟过后。
视频中，陈伯达已经坐回椅子里，语气和神态都收了一些。
开始说话前，他先叹了一口气：“哎，陆总，看得出来你是真喜欢这幅，你也是真深入其中了，夺人之爱不就是跟夺人之妻一个性质吗？我啊，就不跟你抢了、
再说了，吴雪还这么年轻，我这辈子一定有机会拿到一幅画的。”
说完，陈伯达往后靠了靠，低头思考了一下，看表情还是有些不服。
果然，他眉毛一挑，立马抬起头说道：“但我有个条件！
你买了以后，每年你得拿出来一个月，放到展览馆去！
任何人都能去参观！
如果你不同意的画我就一直跟你加钱，你出多少都在价格之上加五百万！
而且我买回家之后绝对不会展出，就把它锁在柜子里，任何人都看不了！
到时候肯定会有人说我糟蹋艺术，那我就有话说了，都是你陆行舟搞得大家都看不了画！”
说完，陈伯达一脸傲娇，一副看你怎么办的样子。
看完之后林默也笑眯眯的，没想到还有这种环节，有意思了。
二十分钟后
陆行舟只是回复了一条文字，本人没有出镜：“每年一个月？行吧，你这家伙真是诡计多端。”
陈伯达在一分钟后留了条评论：
“切，不诡计多端一点，大家以后就看不见这幅画了，我这是在为广大艺术爱好者谋福利，你这种没有心，只会用金融噶韭菜的家伙是不会懂的。”
content_en:
Is Wu Xuecheng a domineering president? Lin Mo observed the micro-expressions of the two people again and came to the conclusion that both of them were acting.
Because both of them have serious acting marks.
This method is very clever, allowing two rich people to ask for prices remotely on the Internet, which can increase a lot of topics for discussion.
The identity of the rich man, his bid, etc.
Of course, all of this is to enhance the value of Wu Xue's painting.
The art world’s comments are too abstract, and the psychotherapist’s comments are understandable but not concrete enough.
The rich man’s bid is the most intuitive and impactful!
All the steps add up to a perfect hype combo!
The audience may not understand what "dialogue between the painter and the soul" means, but everyone definitely understands "Thirty Million"
Thinking about it, Lin Mo smiled and shook his head: "Being able to invite two billionaires to interact with each other, Professor Guo's energy is not small."
Continue playing Lu Xingzhou’s video.
After he quoted the price and put down the note, he said very seriously to the camera:
Mr. Chen, you can distinguish clearly, you see accurately, you understand best. Okay, then let me ask you, when you were painting at three o'clock in the morning, did you feel that the outline of the mass moved?
Have you ever turned the light off and on again to see if it's still in place?
Look me in the eyes and answer me! "
Lu Xingzhou stared at the screen for more than ten seconds before continuing:
"Mr. Chen, you know, no matter what time, place or angle I look at that painting, I can always feel a different experience! I can experience different feelings just by staring at it, so I think it is worth the 30 million! "
When he finished saying this, Lu Xingzhou's lips were trembling.
After watching it, Lin Mo was sighing, did Lu Xingzhou minor in acting in his spare time?
I don’t know how many times his acting skills are better than those of the little fresh actors on the market.
After the video was posted, Chen Boda responded ten minutes later.
In the video, Chen Boda has sat back in his chair, his tone and demeanor calming down a bit.
Before he started to speak, he sighed: "Hey, Mr. Lu, I can see that you really like this picture, and you are really into it. Isn't seizing someone's love the same as seizing someone's wife? I won’t rob you.
Besides, Wu Xue is still so young, I will definitely have a chance to get a painting in my life. "
After saying that, Chen Boda leaned back, lowered his head and thought for a while, but his expression was still a bit dissatisfied.
Sure enough, he raised his eyebrows, raised his head immediately and said, "But I have a condition!
After you buy it, you have to take it out for one month every year and put it in the exhibition hall!
Anyone can visit!
If you don’t agree with the painting, I will keep asking you to increase the money. Whatever you pay will be added to the price by five million!
And I will never display it after I buy it home, I will just lock it in the cabinet so no one can see it!
At that time, some people will definitely say that I am trashing art, and then I will have something to say. It is you, Lu Xingzhou, who has made it impossible for everyone to see paintings! "
After saying that, Chen Boda looked arrogant and looked like he was waiting to see what you would do.
After reading it, Lin Mo also smiled. He didn't expect there would be such a link, it was so interesting.
twenty minutes later
Lu Xingzhou just replied with a text without appearing in the scene: "One month every year? Okay, you're a very cunning guy. "
Chen Boda left a comment a minute later:
"Tch, if you don't use more tricks, you won't be able to see this painting in the future. I am doing this for the benefit of art lovers. A heartless guy like you, who only knows how to use finance, won't understand. "
